name: Vina City 🏠 RP
desc:
👍 Welcome to Vina RP, a city roleplay experience, where players choose their own roles and roleplay everyday life.

🌟 Choose from many fashionable houses, beautiful cars, avatar catalog accessories, roleplay props and roleplay tools to enhance your experience!

🍜 Serve dishes at a local restaurant or become a coffee barista ☕
🏥 Visit the hospital and roleplay medical scenarios! 🏥
🌍 Join our friendly roleplay & avatar sim community🌍
🚌 Drive a bus to carry people around the city 🚌
& more!

Category: Roleplay, Town & City, Explore, RP
